rationale.text: No element carries a language indication, and all the text is drawn in a font family the page defines itself with @font-face, as most sites do. By the wording, the page has no indication on html or on its texts. But the custom check takes a text as a witness only in a generic or pinned system family that the page does not define, so that a fault never rests on an icon or symbol font; here no text qualifies and it answers cannot_tell (step 4). Only the record supports this branch; the tool leaves it to a human. axe's html-has-lang faults through an evidence-only link, so the reason at full is alternative_unresolved; at fail_only, needs_review, not_enabled.

citations.quote: Pour chaque page web, l’indication de langue par défaut vérifie-t-elle une de ces conditions
L’indication de la langue de la page (attribut `lang` et/ou `xml:lang`) est donnée pour l’élément `html`
L’indication de la langue de la page (attribut `lang` et/ou `xml:lang`) est donnée sur chaque élément de texte ou sur l’un des éléments parents.
